|lore=Infamous '''bounty hunter'''. Hired to help Jabba intimidate debtors and smugglers. Crack shot. Mandalorian armor and jet pack provide protection and flight capability.
|game_text=P 3, 4: Slave I. If a battle was just initiated at same site, may target one opposing character present. Draw destiny. If destiny +2 > ability, target captured. May ‘fly’ (landspeed = 3). Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 if with Han or Jabba).
|errata_history=Versions of '''Boba Fett (Special Edition persona only) (V)''' in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): release sheet “Virtual Set #8” (Players Committee; released 24 November 2004; PDF dated 24 November 2004), page 2, slip 28 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 5 December 2004), announced in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news post of 24 November 2004]: “P 3, 4: Slave I. If a battle was just initiated at same site, may target one opposing character present. Draw destiny. If destiny +2 > ability, target captured. May ‘fly’ (landspeed = 3). Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 if with Han or Jabba).” Stats line: “POWER 4 ABILITY 3 ARMOR 5”. Deploy 4, forfeit 7. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “8•28” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Boba Fett (Special Edition persona only) (V) (Virtual Set 8) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007; later 2007 re-edits included], slip 28), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots (4 if ''Slave I''). May ‘fly’ (landspeed = 3). During battle, may target an opponent’s character present with Boba Fett. Draw destiny. Target captured if destiny +2 > ability. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while with Han or Jabba).” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
